# Liran Tal — lirantal.com

Liran Tal's personal website and technical blog. It covers AI and agent security, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Node.js secure coding, software supply-chain security, open-source projects, books, research, and conference talks.

## When to use this site

- Find or cite Liran Tal's articles about agentic security, MCP, Node.js, and software supply-chain security.
- Browse his open-source projects, preprint research, books, speaking engagements, and published articles.
- Retrieve public blog metadata from the read-only JSON API, then fetch the full article from its Markdown URL.

The public site is read-only and requires no authentication. It does not provide a dedicated MCP server or write API. Respect the site's crawler policy in `/robots.txt` and the `Content-Signal` declaration there.

## Content formats

HTML pages advertise Markdown twins with `rel="alternate"`. The homepage Markdown is available at [index.md](https://lirantal.com/index.md); append `.md` to an article URL to fetch its Markdown twin. Requests with `Accept: text/markdown` also receive Markdown on supported production routes.

## Access and API

All listed HTTP resources are public GET endpoints with no authentication. The post API returns published metadata sorted newest first; it is not a search API, but clients can filter the returned titles, descriptions, categories, and tags locally. Article content is available from each post's `markdownUrl`.

For agent-oriented browser search, open [the blog directory](https://lirantal.com/writing), which exposes a WebMCP `search_blog_posts` tool when the browser supports WebMCP.
